texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Legal and Administrative Documents in the Cambridge Genizah Collections (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1993).
texts.html:
1. [In the name of God, the merciful and compassionate.]

  2. [ … ] the daughter of Saʿīd, the Jewish builder,

  3. [ … ] the daughter of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaḥyā

  4. [ … ] the worker in brass. They both bought from the two of them together

  5. [ … ]these two sellers that it 

  6. [ …. a half] and a quarter, eighteen shares from 

  7. [twenty-four shares … from twenty four] shares, held in common. 

  8. [ … ] previously in the ownership of [ … ] .......... 

  9. [ … ] they cumulatively acquired through their prior ownership 

  10. [ … ] what is in it with all its existing rights

  11. [ … ] with a decorative ceiling, the entire upper floor of which was not connected with any part of it, and they

  12. [ … ] that this ground floor mentioned in it 

  13. [ … ] ... in Fusṭāṭ, over the water of which there is a tank

  14. [ … ] ... […] this lane facing anyone who enters

  15. [ … ] four boundaries enclose it. The first boundary, which is the southern,

  16. [ … ] known as the Fortress of the Greeks, and to the square of the aforementioned lane, which is joined to it

  17. [ … ] known as the Fortress of the Candles. The third boundary, which is the eastern,

  18. [ … ] ............... and the [fourth] boundary,

  19. [which is the western, … ] its rights, its land, its building, its door,

  20. [ … ] every right attached to it, within

  21. [and without … ] mentioned in this document

  22. [ … ] which is currency in Fusṭāṭ, free from commission ...
